info.title: Shopping Cart API
info.description:
REST API for the shopping cart: catalog, cart, checkout with Razorpay, Shiprocket shipping,
search and admin catalog management.

**Authentication.** Get tokens from `POST /api/v1/auth/login` and send the access token as
`Authorization: Bearer <token>`. Access tokens last 15 minutes; use `POST /api/v1/auth/refresh`
with the refresh token to get a new pair.

**Money.** All amounts are integers in paise (₹1 = 100 paise), currency INR.

**Errors.** Validation errors return `422`. Stock conflicts return `409` with the available quantity.

schema.title: Response List Categories Api V1 Categories Get

get.description: List active products, filtered by category, brand, price (paise) and stock. Cached in Redis.
Get an active product by its slug. Cached in Redis; each request counts as a view.

Full-text search with brand, category, colour, size and price facets.

Each facet's counts ignore its own selection, so other options stay visible. If the
search engine is unavailable, falls back to database filtering with `facets: null`.
Get the cart with current prices, shipping fee and total.

post.description: Add a product, or increase its quantity if it is already in the cart. 409 if stock is short.

patch.description: Set the quantity of a cart item.

delete.description: Remove an item from the cart.

post.description:
Place an order from the cart and get the details to open Razorpay Checkout.

Returns `409` if stock ran out and `502` if Razorpay is unavailable (the order is
cancelled and the cart kept).
Get the Razorpay details again to pay an unpaid order, e.g. after closing the payment window.

Public demo only: simulate a successful payment and get what Razorpay Checkout would return,
to confirm with `verify-payment`. `404` unless the server runs with `DEMO_PAYMENTS`.
Confirm a payment with the signature Razorpay Checkout returned. `422` if the signature is wrong.
Cancel an unpaid order and release its stock. `409` once it is paid.

get.description: Courier, AWB and tracking timeline for an order. The timeline is cached for 10 minutes.
List all products, including archived ones, optionally searched by SKU or name.

post.description: Create a product. The slug is generated from the name if not given.

patch.description: Update a product, e.g. its price or stock.

delete.description: Archive a product instead of deleting it, so past orders keep their link to it.
Delete an empty category. 409 if it still has products.

get.description: All orders, newest first, with payment and shipment state.
Today's orders and revenue, what needs shipping, 7-day revenue, low stock and hot products.

Live numbers from this server: latency of recent API requests, cache hit rate, checkout
outcomes and the latest events written to the outbox.

post.description:
Public demo only: ten buyers check out the last three units at the same moment, on
separate database connections. With `locked=true` the real checkout runs; with `false`, a
naive read-then-write version shows the race the lock prevents.

Receive Razorpay payment events, verified with the HMAC signature of the raw body.

The event is recorded in the same transaction as its effect, so either both commit or
neither does and Razorpay's retry is processed. Repeated deliveries return `duplicate`.

schema.title: Response Razorpay Webhook Api Webhooks Razorpay Post

post.description:
Receive Shiprocket shipment status updates, authenticated with the `x-api-key` header.

Shiprocket sends no event id, so the AWB and status identify a delivery. Orders only
move forward (paid, shipped, delivered), so late or repeated updates change nothing.
